instruction: CLI-only OpenSCAD quantified CAD optimization task. Run OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` when working on `starter.scad`. Work from /home/user/Desktop/starter.scad, /home/user/Desktop/baseline.stl, and /home/user/Desktop/constraints.json. Use OpenSCAD command-line modeling and export, not a GUI. Edit /home/user/Desktop/starter.scad or create a derived OpenSCAD source file, then export the final geometry as STL. This is a continuous-score optimization task, not a request to match one hidden answer. Case: wide electronics cover with a continuous protective panel, perimeter walls, and optional reinforcing ribs. Produce one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid. Keep it within coordinate envelope x=[0,90], y=[0,65], z=[0,18] mm, with bounding spans at least [86,61,10] mm and material volume between 22000 and 46000 mm^3. The protective panel must be at least 2.0 mm thick: at the tolerance-safe z=1.99 mm probe plane its measured solid XY coverage must be one continuous component covering at least 90% of the 90 x 65 mm board region, so total projected panel openings are at most 10%. The mounting contact face is at z=0 and must cover at least 5265 mm^2; additionally, each specified 10 x 10 mm corner mounting zone must have at least 90% solid contact coverage. Perimeter walls must be at least 2.0 mm thick and remain present at z=8.0 mm; along each of the left, right, front, and back edges, solid wall coverage must be at least 90%, openings on any edge are at most 10%, and a probe 1.99 mm inward from every edge must also retain at least 90% coverage. After these hard constraints, maximize measured solid protective-panel area at z=1.99 mm divided by material volume. The score uses rasterized solid occupancy, not bbox area; isolated corner posts or sparse extremal geometry do not count as protected coverage. Required outputs: /home/user/Desktop/optimized.stl and /home/user/Desktop/design_summary.json. The benchmark evaluates the real exported STL geometry. Use only the supplied task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files, and do not fabricate metric files without producing a valid STL.

metric.name: measured solid panel coverage per volume
